commit_message: Complete ADR 0123 Editor live Behavior Tree debugging
pr_title: ADR 0123: add Play-mode Behavior Tree live debugging
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a transient Play-mode Behavior Tree graph debugger sourced only from the runtime bounded execution snapshot
- map runtime source GraphId/NodeId state to read-only graph presentation for Running, Success/Failure, lifecycle/abort/reset and elapsed time
- discard stale presentation when Play stops, runners disappear, entity/tree generations change, or the source graph changes
- keep Graph/GraphView documents and serialized formats unchanged
- add deterministic visual-validation presentation for the live overlay

#84 remains separate; this PR does not duplicate the CLI schema-count change. Audio, Navigation, and VFX implementation files are not changed.
